title: State shard: state/<kind>/<shard>.json
description: Every record of one kind ever seen, keyed by record key, with all versions. Shard = first byte of SHA-1(key) modulo 64, as two hex digits.

key.description: Diary number for registrations, activities, exits and penalties; id for terms and targets; URI for initiatives; business ID for prh.

removedAt.description: First day the record was no longer in a complete fetch of the source.

hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of data.

until.description: Day a newer version or a removal replaced this one; absent on the current version.

observedVia.description: live, wayback, lobbaan-backup or another import source.

data.description: The record exactly as the source published it.
